manifest_row.title: Should Governments Slap a Tax on Plastic? | WIRED

screening.main_topic: A proposed California tax on single-use plastic packaging and its effects on pollution, recycling, consumers, and manufacturers.
screening.climate_relevance: The article meaningfully compares the plastic tax with carbon taxes, discusses climate change as the externality addressed by carbon pricing, and considers greenhouse-gas emissions from possible packaging substitutions and transport.

A separate promotional snippet about a climate-change map appears near the end and is not part of the main article.
